newsitem.title: USA: MOSCOM to cut back operations.
newsitem.headline: MOSCOM to cut back operations.

text.p: MOSCOM Corp said on Wednesday that it is cutting back its operations and expects to post a "substantial" charge in the second quarter for the restructuring.

"We need to eliminate unprofitable business segments that have masked our profitable core and severely strained MOSCOM's management and financial resources," company president David Mazzella said in a statement.
MOSCOM said it has ceased research and new product development of voice verification products, but will continue the sales of existing products.
The company is going to cut annual operating expenses at its European units by $2.2 million by the end of June.
The company's cost-cutting overall should cut MOSCOM's break even level by approximately $5 million for the year and it expects to return to positive cash flow by year end, MOSCOM said.
